visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with brown hair tied in a clip stands in a bright kitchen, putting on a beige apron over a light grey fleece sweater. The background features a white microwave and a rice cooker on a wooden shelf. (2) Close-up shots of various food ingredients on a white countertop: a jar of tomato sauce, a pack of spaghetti, mushrooms in a plastic tray, green bell peppers in a bag, and a pack of sausages. A pair of tan slippers is visible on the floor. (3) The camera captures hands washing white mushrooms in a metal mesh strainer under a running faucet. Then, a chef's knife slices through a green pepper on a grey cutting board, followed by mushrooms being sliced into thin pieces. (4) The woman uses scissors to open a plastic pack of sausages and slices them diagonally on the cutting board. She then opens a small plastic container filled with red chili peppers and uses scissors to snip one into small rings. (5) In a stainless steel pot, spaghetti boils in water while olive oil is poured into a beige frying pan on an induction stove. The sliced peppers, mushrooms, and sausages are added to the pan and stirred with wooden-handled tongs. (6) The woman uses tongs to transfer the cooked spaghetti from the pot into the frying pan with the sautéed ingredients. She adds several spoonfuls of red sauce from a jar and tosses everything together until the pasta is well-coated. (7) The finished Neapolitan pasta is plated on a white floral-edged plate. A hand sprinkles white cheese powder from a tall green and white container over the steaming dish. (8) The woman sits at a wooden dining table with a tablet propped up on a stand. She uses a fork to twirl a large portion of pasta and brings it to her mouth, eating while watching a video on the screen.
